 .shark-university-widget {
 font-family: 'Open Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
 background-color: #f8fbfd;
 border-radius: 12px; 
 box-shadow: 0 6px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
 border: 1px solid #e1e7ec;
 overflow: hidden;
 color: #333;
 }

 .shark-widget-header {
 background-color: #0d2c4c; 
 color: #ffffff;
 padding: 20px 25px;
 font-size: 1.6em;
 font-weight: 600;
 letter-spacing: 0.5px;
 display: flex;
 align-items: center;
 border-bottom: 2px solid #0a2542;
 }

 .shark-widget-header i {
 margin-right: 15px;
 font-size: 1.2em;
 color: #38bdf8;
 }

 .shark-widget-body {
 padding: 25px;
 }

 .shark-welcome {
 margin-bottom: 30px;
 border-bottom: 1px solid #e1e7ec;
 padding-bottom: 15px;
 }

 .shark-welcome h2 {
 font-size: 1.4em;
 font-weight: 600;
 color: #0d2c4c;
 margin-top: 0;
 margin-bottom: 8px;
 }

 .shark-welcome p {
 font-size: 1em;
 line-height: 1.5;
 color: #5c6c7b;
 margin: 0;
 }

 .shark-section-title {
 font-size: 1.1em;
 font-weight: 600;
 color: #0d2c4c;
 margin-top: 0;
 margin-bottom: 20px;
 text-transform: uppercase;
 letter-spacing: 1px;
 }

 .shark-actions-grid {
 display: grid;
 grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); 
 gap: 20px;
 margin-bottom: 30px;
 }

 .shark-action-card {
 background-color: #ffffff;
 border: 1px solid #e1e7ec;
 border-radius: 10px;
 padding: 25px 20px;
 text-align: center;
 text-decoration: none;
 color: #0d2c4c;
 transition: all 0.3s ease; 
 display: flex;
 flex-direction: column;
 align-items: center;
 justify-content: center;
 }

 .shark-action-card:hover {
 border-color: #38bdf8;
 transform: translateY(-5px); 
 box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15);
 }

 .shark-action-card i {
 font-size: 2.5em;
 color: #38bdf8;
 margin-bottom: 15px;
 }

 .shark-action-card .action-text {
 font-size: 1em;
 font-weight: 600;
 line-height: 1.2;
 }

 .shark-quickaccess-list {
 background-color: #ffffff;
 border: 1px solid #e1e7ec;
 border-radius: 10px;
 padding: 15px;
 margin: 0;
 list-style: none;
 }

 .shark-quickaccess-item {
 border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;
 }

 .shark-quickaccess-item:last-child {
 border-bottom: none;
 }

 .shark-quickaccess-link {
 display: flex;
 align-items: center;
 text-decoration: none;
 padding: 12px 10px;
 transition: background-color 0.2s ease;
 border-radius: 6px;
 }

 .shark-quickaccess-link:hover {
 background-color: #f1f8fc;
 }

 .quickaccess-icon {
 font-size: 1.2em;
 color: #38bdf8;
 margin-right: 15px;
 width: 25px; 
 text-align: center;
 }

 .quickaccess-text {
 font-size: 1em;
 color: #333;
 font-weight: 500;
 }

</style>
